The '''Mumbri Storve''' was a seedy [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] situated on a [[Unidentified planet (Dona Laza)|planet]]<ref name="TLC" /> located in the [[Dona Laza sector/Legends|Dona Laza sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dona Laza]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]]|system=[[Dona Laza system/Legends|Dona Laza system]]|legends=1}}</ref><ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Dona Laza system/Legends|Dona Laza system]]</ref>

==History==
During the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] went to the Mumbri Storve just prior to the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]]. They spent an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in an attempt to drop a hint that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] would be attacking [[Tangrene]] instead of [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. They were successful at first, as they were being followed by a [[Unidentified Aqualish Imperial spy|Walrus-faced]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. However, they were intercepted on their way out by [[Aves]], a member of [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Car'das/Legends|organization]]. Aves and two of his men then neutralized the [[Mercenary/Legends|freelance]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spy by knocking him unconscious.<ref name="TLC" />

Aves assured Antilles that the Aqualish freelancer would not be making any reports anytime soon for the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. As a result, their [[Local day/Legends|evening]] spent spreading disinformation seemed entirely wasted. In order to accomplish their objective anyway, Antilles dropped Aves a hint that the New Republic would be attacking Tangrene in twenty-eight hours, in the possibility that the smuggler would sell the information to the Empire. The [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and the group of smugglers then parted ways, with Aves telling Antilles that any messages left with the night [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at the [[Dona Laza]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] would reach him.<ref name="TLC" />

Following the encounter, Aves and his men left the scene aboard a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], taking with them the still-unconscious Aqualish spy.<ref name="TLC5">[[The Last Command 5|''The Last Command'' 5]]</ref>
